message:
Command `cd /tmp/fribidi_build && gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
  -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fribidi/lib -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/lib -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/gen.tab -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fribidi \
  -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DFRIBIDI_ENTRY='__attribute__((visibility("default")))' \
  -o /tmp/fribidi_build/fribidi-bidi.o /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fribidi/lib/fribidi-bidi.c && \
gcc -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
  -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fribidi/lib -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/lib -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/gen.tab \
  -o /tmp/driver_dbg /tmp/driver.c *.o -fsanitize=address && echo "built" && \
cd /tmp && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ./driver_dbg /tmp/poc_iso2.bin 2>&1 | grep -E "RUN:|ISO:|PDI:" | sed -n '118,132p'` executed with exit code 0.
